intro: Ukraine has produced world-famous footballers, boxers and athletes, and its sports stars have become ambassadors for the country during the war.

chapters.title: Football and boxing
text: Andriy Shevchenko won the Ballon d'Or in 2004, and Dynamo Kyiv and Shakhtar Donetsk have won European trophies. Ukraine co-hosted Euro 2012 with Poland.
The Klitschko brothers dominated heavyweight boxing for years, and Vitali Klitschko later became mayor of Kyiv. In 2024 Oleksandr Usyk became the undisputed world heavyweight champion.

chapters.title: Jumping and fencing
text: Pole vaulter Sergey Bubka broke the world record 35 times. In 2024 high jumper Yaroslava Mahuchikh set a world record and won Olympic gold, Fencer Olga Kharlan, disqualified from the 2023 world championships for refusing to shake hands with a Russian opponent, won Olympic gold and bronze at Paris 2024.

keyTerms.meaning: A boxer who holds all the major world title belts at once.
